ci: the Release workflow's checks run as parallel jobs under one Test gate, inside 5 minutes

The Test job ran lint, typecheck, the three test tiers and the Rust tests one
after another on one runner: ~7.5 min on main, and the worker tier alone held
~300 s of wall time. They now run as parallel jobs (static checks, unit, four
worker shards, process + e2e), each capped at 4 minutes, and Test is the one
gate over them: it joins every job's test records, reports by layer, and names
any job that did not pass.

Refs brandon-unfiled-3248.o44h
